whoIAm.heading: Who I Am
paragraphs: I'm Luca Cacchiani, founder of LX Software. I work with Hong Kong startups and small teams as a fractional CTO or CIO: senior technical leadership, architecture, hiring support, and delivery accountability without the cost of a full-time executive.

My focus is AI, cloud, and microservices. I've built and scaled products including Evolve Sprouts (Montessori training for families), Siu Tin Dei (curated activities for kids in Hong Kong), and ai-cxo (an AI-powered SaaS for running a company with AI CEO, CTO, and CIO roles).

whatIDo.heading: What I Do
whatIDo.intro: I plug in where the technical gap is: strategy, architecture, hiring, delivery, or rescue. Engagements can be a few days a month, a fixed project, or an interim leadership role.

contact.heading: Contact Me
contact.intro: Need a fractional CTO, CIO, or AI/cloud lead? Tell me what you're building, where you're stuck, and what "scale" means for you. I'll reply with a clear next step.

faq.a: LX Software is the consulting studio of Luca Cacchiani, a Hong Kong-based fractional CTO and CIO. I help startups scale with AI, cloud, and microservices.

faq.q: What is a fractional CTO or CIO?
faq.a: It's senior technical leadership on a part-time or interim basis. You get CTO/CIO-level strategy, architecture, hiring, and delivery without the cost of a full-time executive.

faq.q: Do you work with Hong Kong startups?
faq.a: Yes. I'm based in Hong Kong and work with local and remote-first startups. Engagements can be advisory, hands-on, or a mix of both.

faq.q: Which technologies do you work with?
faq.a: AWS (serverless, containers, CDK), TypeScript and React, Python, SQL, and LLM tooling. I favour event-driven microservices, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD with observability built in.

faq.q: How do I get in touch?
faq.a: Use the Contact Me section: telephone, email, WhatsApp, WeChat, or LinkedIn, whichever is configured. Email reaches hello@lx-software.com.

faq.q: Does this site collect email addresses?
faq.a: No. There is no newsletter signup and no account. If you write, call, or message, that conversation is used only to reply.

sections.heading: Who
paragraphs: This site is published by Luca Cacchiani / LX Software, an independent software and consulting studio in Hong Kong. The contact mailbox is hello@lx-software.com.

sections.heading: What this site collects
paragraphs: The site does not run accounts, comments, or a newsletter. It does not ask you to create a profile.
The host keeps ordinary server logs (IP address, user agent, requested URL, and time) to operate and secure the site. Those logs are not used for advertising.

sections.heading: When you get in touch
paragraphs: If you email, call, or message through the contact links, I use that conversation to reply. I do not sell it and I do not add you to a mailing list.

sections.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: The site uses Google Analytics 4, loaded through Google Tag Manager, to count visits and see which pages, sections, links, and buttons are used (for example which contact channel or FAQ entry was opened). It records the kind of link, not the number or address behind it. Google sets first-party cookies (_ga and _ga_*) to tell returning visitors from new ones. The data is aggregated and is not used for advertising. Google's own privacy policy applies to that processing.

If your browser sends the Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track signal, the analytics script is not loaded at all. You can also block it with a content blocker or the Google Analytics opt-out add-on.

sections.heading: Cookies and media
paragraphs: This site does not set advertising cookies. Beyond the analytics cookies above, it sets none of its own. The harbour video is decoration. It has no audio and carries no extra tracking pixel of its own. It is served from this site, or from media.lx-software.com when that host is configured.
Links to LinkedIn, WhatsApp, WeChat, and the project sites leave this site. Those services have their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: Using the site
paragraphs: The pages are information about LX Software and Luca Cacchiani. They are not an offer to contract. Project descriptions are provided for context and may change.

sections.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: The site is provided as published. I do not warrant that it will be uninterrupted or free of errors.

sections.heading: Questions
